title: Iris walks the hall
direction: Iris. Walk the hall. On pick, take the path without hesitation. Never read the card face.

beats.voice: I'm Iris. This is the first time we walk this hall together. I only know what you choose to show me. That can deepen. It never has to.
This is why money you already paid can come home as leftover that is actually yours. When you're ready, take it. I know the door.
This is the leak in a place you actually stand. If you pick it, we go to the address. I won't sell you a dashboard.
This one is me, on the table. You ask. I conduct. You can tell me no.
You may look without buying. If you want depth, I take you to a door with a price you can hear.
Stand. No costume to enter. If you pick it, we make one name so you stop living as ten logins.
That's the hall. Stay with me or point at a room. I'll take you there.

picks.voice: Good. Look first — leftover after you already paid. Nothing sealed until you say so.
